name: Miraneko
source:
Natalie used to think of summer as fun in the sun, a break from college, or time to pick up a quick part-time gig. However, with growing academic pressure to declare her major before the fall semester starts, Natalie finds it impossible to enjoy summer with the rest of her friends.

To make things more complicated, she just so happened to meet Sonny, a cat-eared kemonomimi, trying to find their “life’s purpose” in her compost bin. The two find solidarity in their situations as Sonny can’t go back home without a self-proclaimed destiny and Nattie wants nothing to do with finding her calling in life.

Guide Sonny and Natalie through various events and minigames and lead them to one of many fates waiting for them. 

[Edited from [url=https://the-riversitters.itch.io/miraneko]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
娜塔莉曾经认为夏天是阳光下的乐趣，是大学毕业后的休息时间，或者是找一份快速兼职工作的时间。然而，随着秋季学期开始前申报专业的学业压力越来越大，娜塔莉发现不可能和其他朋友一起享受夏天。

更复杂的是，她碰巧遇到了桑尼，一只猫耳兽，试图在堆肥箱中找到它们的“人生目标”。两人在各自的处境中找到了团结，因为桑尼如果没有自称的命运就无法回家，而纳蒂不想与寻找自己的人生使命有任何关系。

引导桑尼和娜塔莉完成各种事件和小游戏，引导他们走向等待着他们的众多命运之一。

[编辑自[url=https://the-riversitters.itch.io/miraneko]itch.io[/url]]
